card.name: Capital R starting RENAL in all-caps
card.fires_on: The lone capital letter R that begins the word RENAL in all-caps warning text, usually after "patients with" or "impaired". It sometimes also fires on R starting other all-caps warning words such as RISK.

modes.label: R of RENAL
modes.description: The single letter R split off from ENAL in all-caps headings about kidney function, disease or impairment.

modes.description: The R starting another all-caps word in a boxed warning title, such as RISK.
